mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.status IN ('ABORTED', 'EXPIRED') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment_cancellations AS cancellation WHERE cancellation.payment_id = payment.id AND cancellation.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'FAILED') AND NOT ( cancellation.request_type = 'SYSTEM_COMPENSATION' AND cancellation.status = 'FAILED' AND cancellation.failure_code = 'PAYMENT_COMPLETED' ) )
